text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My first three years in the Twinkle Series with Kitasan Black have come to a close, and in that time, she's gone from an unknown racer to a household name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always been one to extend a hand to those in need, but now those hands reach much further than before…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the way to the northern wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go, everyone! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The kids chase and chase after Kitasan Black as she runs along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both the fast and slow kids are overjoyed by the game. After most of the kids are completely exhausted…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Can you still run? You look pretty tired… You sure you're okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Yeah! I'm fine! Running is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You know what? I want to run in races like you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ohh, is that so? Well, I'm sure you'll make your dream come true someday!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Oh, but… I dunno if I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: There aren't any running classes 'round where I live, and there're loads of kids who are much faster than me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. You can't run as well as you'd like right now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All right, show me your face!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My face? Is somethin' wrong with it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I might be able to learn something about you by looking at your face. Let me take a peek. ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-uh, okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black looks deep into the child's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Good! She has a great look in her eyes. They're shining with enthusiasm!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (The bright blue sky is reflected vividly in them, and she's looking straight toward her dream!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay! There's no doubt about it! I'm sure you can be a champion!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? How could you tell just by lookin' at my face? Wouldn't it make more sense to look at my legs?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nope! A person's face and eyes tell the most about whether they can run fast or not!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If you're overflowing with motivation, you'll be able to keep running without losing hope, no matter how long it takes for you to succeed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's difficult to know what the future holds for an Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Kitasan Black has showed me that the most important thing isn't a person's bloodline or the flashiness of their running.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It might be scary to dive into a totally unknown world, but just trust me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's charge forward together! I'll always be there to help you out if you get stuck! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Do you really, REALLY mean that? But if I wanna be a racer, there're lotsa things I gotta do, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um… The thing is, my family doesn't have a lotta money…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh! You don't need to worry about that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That is, indeed, right. Whatever support you need, we'll be happy to provide.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We're sponsoring any child who has the motivation to succeed. As long as your parents give us permission, there'll be no problem.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can study running while attending school, and we can provide lodging for you as well if needed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So don't worry about anything and just focus on running with all your heart, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wooow! You're really doin' all that for me? That's awesome!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haha! Isn't it great we met such a nice kid, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Certainly. I found a promising recruit as well.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: E-erm… It's nice to meet you. I want to run too, so um…

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hi! Sounds good! Let's work hard together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black has gone from supportee to supporter. In this northern venture, she searches for promising racers, and the Satono Group provides financial aid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Between her leadership skills and their charity, they've managed to bring racing to another level. And not just through this charity work…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This is fantastic, Kitasan. Seeing the younger runners put all they've got into their races is lighting a real fire in our hearts too!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor
text_block_list.text: Astounding… The Umamusume who did partner running with Kitasan Black before their debut races have all improved dramatically…

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Kitasan Black. The energy at the winning concerts you perform in are always on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Race Attendant
text_block_list.text: We'll have to do even more to improve our racecourse facilities! We won't be able to contain all the excitement during races otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Here and there, wherever Kitasan goes, smiles bloom and flourish on people's faces…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the next year is starting soon. Let's work hard together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The festival we're aiming for is just beginning! We have to keep doing more and more so it can get bigger and bigger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's never known how to stop, and it's no different now. Her ambition and drive are infectious, inspiring all those around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's like none other, and her dream is so much vaster than everyone else's too. I doubt anyone could do as much good for the world as her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I reflect on everything she's done, the words of all those who work with Umamusume spill forth from my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you thanking me for all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: I'm so very glad I became your trainer.
I'm so very glad I became your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-aw, cut that out! Don't just say stuff like that out of nowhere! I'm the one who should be thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you for looking after me and for valuing my enthusiasm so much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I still need to repay you for all your kindness, Trainer! We're nowhere close to even!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll win tons of races, treat everyone to a great time, and put the biggest smiles on my fans' faces!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And I know I can do all that because I'm not alone! I have you and many other friends who will be there for me on my journey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her deeply empathetic heart, born through her own hardships, and willingness to aid everyone truly makes her the clutch captain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's also one thing that sets her apart from even the most talented Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's a sun that has slowly risen from the far reaches of the north. No one can claim her, as she belongs to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, she hangs at the zenith of the sky, shining her light upon all.
